sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsels for the State as well as Informant.
2.

The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Special G.R. Case No.37 of 2021 pending on the file of learned Spl. Judge (POCSO) Act, Bolangir, arising out of Belpada P.S. Case No.64 of 2021 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 354(D), 294, 506, 376(2)(n)
and 376 of IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Informant on instruction that in the meanwhile the victim had attained the marriageable age and out of her own volition had joined the Petitioner in the matrimony.

4. Such submission also finds credence from the report of the DLSA submitted on 23.07.2025 in terms of the order passed by this Court dated 16.07.2025 and is also reflected in the proceeding dated 01.08.2025.
5.

Considering the nature of allegations and the material which has come to the fore, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.
6. It is needless to state that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
